---
title: "Figure 5: Tau peptide fractionation profiles"
output: Markdown file
---

## Purpose

DIA-NN precursor filtering, median aggregation of unmodified peptide sequences, tau 2N4R sequence mapping and plotting of selected tau peptide profiles. Note that reference cytoskeletal/cytosolic profiles can be obtained in the figure 2Ci section, see filter(markers %in% c("Cytoskeleton", "Cytosol")).

## Access and execution

Code is available for inspection can be run using the supplementary MAPT peptide data provided. Restricted participant-level inputs and intermediate objects are not included. Access to any ROSMAP clinical and neuropathological data is subject to the applicable data-use agreements, and can be requested through https://www.radc.rush.edu/ and https://www.synapse.org/. 

## Inputs

- `report.pr_matrix.tsv`: DIA-NN precursor matrix output
- `mapnamesreport.csv`: run-layout mapping; `contaminants.csv`: contaminant list.
- `demogs.xlsx`: restricted subject metadata (only Subject/Group used here).

```{r display-settings, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

## Import, map and filter precursor entries

Original exclusions and filtering order are retained. Excluding semicolon-containing identifiers is described by the code itself; no new proteotypicity criterion has been added.

```{r precursor-import}
library(data.table)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)

# -------------------------------
# 1) Read wide precursor matrix
# -------------------------------
f <- "path/to/report.pr_matrix.tsv" #can be downloaded from ProteomeXchange. Input path for local directory it is saved to.

report_wide <- as.data.table(read_tsv(f))

# metadata columns present in the DIA-NN precursor matrix
meta_cols <- c(
  "Protein.Group",
  "Protein.Ids",
  "Protein.Names",
  "Genes",
  "First.Protein.Description",
  "Proteotypic",
  "Stripped.Sequence",
  "Modified.Sequence",
  "Precursor.Charge",
  "Precursor.Id")

# all other columns are run columns
run_cols <- setdiff(names(report_wide), meta_cols)


# -------------------------------
# 2) Pivot wide -> long
# -------------------------------
report <- melt(
  report_wide,
  id.vars = meta_cols,
  measure.vars = run_cols,
  variable.name = "Run",
  value.name = "Quant",
  variable.factor = FALSE)

rm(report_wide)

# -------------------------------
# 3) Clean run names and create canonical RunID, as with protein matrix
# -------------------------------
prefix <- "^.*/" # Remove acquisition-directory prefixes.
report[, Run := sub(prefix, "", Run)]
report[, Run := sub("\\.mzML$", "", Run)]
report[, Run := sub("_[0-9]{14}(?=\\s|$)", "", Run, perl = TRUE)]
report[, Run := gsub(" ", "_", Run, fixed = TRUE)]

# extract plate / well from run name
tmp <- sub(".*P([0-9]+)_W([0-9]+).*", "\\1;\\2", report$Run)
spl <- tstrsplit(tmp, ";", fixed = TRUE)
report[, `:=`(
  Plate_num = as.integer(spl[[1]]),
  Well_num  = as.integer(spl[[2]])
)]
rm(tmp, spl)

report[, RunID := paste0("P", Plate_num, "_W", Well_num)]

# remove non-experimental wells
report <- report[!(RunID %in% c("P7_W17"))]

# -------------------------------
# 4) Map to experimental layout
# -------------------------------
mapnames <- fread(input_file("mapnamesreport.csv"))
# expected columns: original_names, new_name
setnames(mapnames, old = intersect(names(mapnames), c("original_names")), 
         new = "RunID_old", skip_absent = TRUE)
setnames(mapnames, old = intersect(names(mapnames), c("new_name")), 
         new = "RunID_new", skip_absent = TRUE)

setkey(report, RunID)
setkey(mapnames, RunID_old)

report[mapnames, RunID := fcoalesce(i.RunID_new, RunID)]

# split mapped RunID if now in format Plate-Well-Subject-Fraction
report[, c("Plate", "Well", "Subject", "Fraction") := tstrsplit(RunID, "-", fixed = TRUE, fill = NA)]

# -------------------------------
# 5) Remove contaminants
# -------------------------------
contaminants <- fread(input_file("contaminants.csv"))


report <- report[
  !grepl("cRAP", Protein.Group, fixed = TRUE) & #remove if flagged cRAP in DIANN search
    endsWith(Protein.Names, "_HUMAN") & #remove any non-human entries
    !(Protein.Group %in% contaminants$Accession |
        Genes %in% contaminants$Gene_symbol)
]

# -------------------------------
# 5) Remove non-proteotypic entries
# -------------------------------

report <- report[
  !grepl(";", Protein.Group, fixed = TRUE) & #remove if non-proteotypic peptide
    !grepl(";", Genes, fixed = TRUE) 
]

# -------------------------------
# Drop unneeded helper columns
# -------------------------------
drop_cols <- c("Run", "Plate_num", "Well_num")
report[, (intersect(drop_cols, names(report))) := NULL]

#  ordering
setcolorder(report, c("RunID", "Plate", "Well", "Subject", "Fraction", meta_cols, "Quant"))
```


## Missingness filtering and median peptide aggregation

```{r precursor-filter-and-aggregate}
library(data.table)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) remove technical samples
# - Fraction missing (or Pool)
# - FracPools are Subject %in% c("A8","C5","E3","G1","J8") 
# - known failed run >= 80% missingness P4-W76-G2-2p
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

report <- report[
  !is.na(Fraction) &
    Fraction != "Pool" &
    !Subject %in% c("A8","C5","E3","G1","J8") & #Fractionated pools
    RunID != "P4-W76-G2-2p"]

# counts after technical sample removal are same as after contaminant removal
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) remove precursors with >=70% global missingness across runs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
precursor_missingness <- report[, .(
  prop_missing = mean(is.na(Quant))), by = Precursor.Id]

keep_precursors <- precursor_missingness[prop_missing < 0.7, Precursor.Id]
report <- report[Precursor.Id %in% keep_precursors]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8): median aggregate precursor ions to peptide level
# one row per peptide x run
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

peptide_report <- report[, .(
  Quant = if (all(is.na(Quant))) NA_real_ else median(Quant, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(
  Protein.Group, First.Protein.Description, Genes, Stripped.Sequence, RunID, Plate, Well, Subject, Fraction)]

#order columns
setcolorder(
  peptide_report,
  c("RunID", "Plate", "Well", "Subject", "Fraction",
    "Protein.Group", "First.Protein.Description", "Genes", "Stripped.Sequence", "Quant"))

#inspect
head(peptide_report)

#save locally as cleaned PR matrx
#write_csv(peptide_report, output_file("clean_pr_matrix.csv")) 
```

## Select MAPT peptides and map to tau 2N4R sequence

-the aa sequence was copied from UniProt

```{r tau-sequence-mapping}

MAPT <- peptide_report %>% filter(Protein.Group == "P10636" | Genes == "MAPT")
length(unique(MAPT$Stripped.Sequence)) #29

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# N to C terminal order of 2N4R sequence from uniprot
tau_2N4R <- paste0(
  "") 


# find where MAPT peptides sit in N->C sequence 
mapt_peptides <- sort(unique(MAPT$Stripped.Sequence))

peptide_pos <- tibble(Stripped.Sequence = mapt_peptides) %>%
  mutate(match = str_locate(tau_2N4R, fixed(Stripped.Sequence))[, 1],
         end   = str_locate(tau_2N4R, fixed(Stripped.Sequence))[, 2]) %>%
  arrange(match, end, Stripped.Sequence)
peptide_pos # 24/29 are found in 2N4R sequence (others are in full canonical sequence)
```


## Prepare profiles

Applies a <5% peptide-missingness filter, sequence-position matching and peptide ranges. The 5 unmatched 2N4R sequences are excluded.

```{r tau-peptide-selection}
library(data.table)

### Join by demogs to map disease group (CON/RES/AD-DEM)
demogs <- readxl::read_xlsx("demogs.xlsx") %>% dplyr::select(Subject, Group) 

# Identify low missingness peptides (less then 5% missingness)
setDT(MAPT)
mapt_missingness <- MAPT[, .(
  prop_missing = mean(is.na(Quant))), by = Stripped.Sequence]
keep_precursors <- mapt_missingness[prop_missing < 0.05, Stripped.Sequence]
MAPT <- MAPT[Stripped.Sequence %in% keep_precursors]

length(unique(MAPT$Stripped.Sequence)) #10/29 sequences have 0 missingness, 18 have missingness < 5%

MAPT_plot <- MAPT %>%
  left_join(demogs, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(Fraction = factor(Fraction, levels = as.character(1:7)),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"))) %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stripped.Sequence) %>%
  mutate(log2Quant = log2(Quant),
    total_peptide = sum(Quant, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop = if_else(total_peptide > 0, Quant / total_peptide, NA_real_)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(peptide_pos, by = "Stripped.Sequence") %>%
  mutate(
    peptide_label = paste0(Stripped.Sequence, " (", match, "-", end, ")"),
    peptide_label = factor(
      peptide_label,
      levels = unique(paste0(peptide_pos$Stripped.Sequence, " (", peptide_pos$match, "-", peptide_pos$end, ")")))) %>% filter(!is.na(match) | !is.na(end)) 

ranges <- c(
  "6-23",
  "45-67",
  "181-190",
  "195-209",
  "212-224",
  "260-267",
  "282-290",
  "299-311",
  "354-369",
  "396-406")

filtered_peps <- MAPT_plot %>% filter(grepl(paste(ranges, collapse = "|"), peptide_label))
```


## Summarise log2 and proportional peptide abundance

- note that there are 24-25 possible observations each peptide per disease-fraction
- 24 in fraction 7 due to the removal of the failed sample in fraction 2. Otherwise, 25 for each person per CON/RES/AD-DEM group. Only the observed peptides used in mean and SD caluclations here. 

```{r tau-summary}
MAPT_prop_sum <- filtered_peps %>%
  group_by(Group, Fraction, peptide_label, match) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(prop)),
    mean_prop = sum(prop, na.rm = TRUE)/n_obs, 
    sd = sd(prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n_obs), 
    .groups = "drop")

MAPT_log_sum <- filtered_peps %>%
  group_by(Group, Fraction, peptide_label, match) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(log2Quant)),
    mean_log2Quant = sum(log2Quant, na.rm = TRUE)/n_obs,
    sd = sd(log2Quant, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n_obs),
    .groups = "drop")

```


## Figure 5: Plot peptide profiles in sequence order


```{r tau-profile-plots}

condition_palette <- c("CON" = "royalblue1", "RES" = "yellowgreen", "AD-DEM" = "indianred2")
prop_plot <- ggplot(
  MAPT_prop_sum,
  aes(x = Fraction, y = mean_prop, color = Group, group = Group)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_prop - sem, ymax = mean_prop + sem, fill = Group, color = NULL),
    alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ peptide_label, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Fraction",  y = "Mean proportion (±SEM)",
    color = "Group", fill = "Group") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title  = element_text(size   = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 4, face = "bold"))

log_plot <- ggplot(
  MAPT_log_sum,
  aes(x = Fraction, y = mean_log2Quant, color = Group, group = Group)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_log2Quant - sem, ymax = mean_log2Quant + sem, fill = Group, color = NULL),
    alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ peptide_label, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Fraction",  y = "Mean log2 intensity (±SEM)",
       #subtitle = "all peptides at <5% missingness",
    color = "Group", fill = "Group") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title  = element_text(size   = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 4, face = "bold"))

library(patchwork)
prop_plot / log_plot
```
